tools.name: get_sweden_market_intelligence
tools.description: Retrieve the latest machine-readable TSRE Daily Investment Desk for Swedish equities, including market regime, breadth, sector rotation, RS20 candidates and Tactical Radar. Research decision support; not an autonomous buy/sell signal.
